I visited this place on a weekend evening with four companions.
I visited with my group on a weekend evening and experienced racial discrimination against people of color.

Each of us ordered one drink, and we also ordered a dessert.
I visited with a group of 4 people and ordered one drink per person and one dessert.

During our visit, one of our friends—who is a foreigner—mistakenly thought a tray at the pickup counter was ours, as the drinks looked the same as what we had ordered. The moment they reached for it, a staff member reacted very aggressively.
One of our foreign friends who was with us confused another customer's tray with our table's tray, and as soon as he tried to take the tray from the pick-up table, the staff member got angry.

They asked repeatedly, “What’s your number?! What number are you?!” in a very irritated and hostile tone.
How many times do you say it out loud?? He repeated the question, “How many times?”, showing his irritation and discomfort.

Judging by their age and demeanor, the person seemed to be either a manager or a senior staff member.
Since you are not young, I think you are either a clerk or a store manager. Is it right to treat customers this way?

I was shocked by how unprofessional and disrespectful their attitude was.
Rather, I was very embarrassed when the person cleaning behind the counter suddenly came and got angry while the part-timer at the counter was kindly trying to teach me.

What’s worse, a younger staff member at the counter was actually trying to kindly explain the situation, but the person cleaning nearby suddenly rushed over and started scolding us harshly.
My friend was confused because the menu we ordered was the same as the drink menu for the person behind us, but he got angry because he thought we couldn't speak Korean based on how we looked.

It was obvious that the staff member assumed the foreigner didn’t speak Korean and wouldn’t be able to file a complaint.
Since foreigners don't speak Korean, they don't seem to be able to file complaints, so did you think it was okay to respond that way?

They directed all their anger only at our foreign friend, completely ignoring the Korean friend standing right next to them. How should we interpret that kind of behavior?
How can I accept that you only get annoyed by a foreign acquaintance while not making eye contact with the Korean friend who was sitting next to you?

Did we steal a drink?
Did we steal your drink?

Did we take someone else’s order and drink it?
Or did you indulge in another customer's drink?

No—we made a simple mistake based on a misunderstanding. And yet, the way we were treated was deeply offensive and discriminatory.
I made a mistake due to a misunderstanding, but I was impressed by the way he continued to push me and get angry.

We have no intention of returning.
I have no intention of visiting again.

Foreign visitors, please be cautious when visiting this place.
Foreigners be careful when visiting.

Not long ago, I won a theater ticket and went out for cultural activities. I like it. It was a day where I made an appointment at Daehakro in Hyehwa, where I've been for the first time in a while, and had a delicious dinner and watched a performance! Memories always become more beautiful and precious when they pass by, so I will capture the memories of this day :-)
​
Although this is a place I blindly led my group to,
When I was looking for a restaurant in Daehakro, Hyehwa, I wasn't confident.
What is the atmosphere as soon as you enter the entrance...?!
It was a very quiet and mysterious space.
It feels like being invited to a meal at a normal home...
​
The interior has a warm and cozy feel.
When you enter, it is quite spacious.
Dating as well as visiting friends and family
This is a restaurant in Daehakro that I would highly recommend.
​
#Gopchang Budae Jjigae 23,000 won
The first thing I was able to see was tripe budae stew...
I really wanted to eat stew and I also like tripe.
This menu is really novel and you can feel it even without trying it.
It was delicious food. It was like tripe hotpot.
Is the inside filled with the ingredients of Budae Jjigae?
Boil it moderately and the vegetables will wilt.
From then on, it was just right to pick it up and eat it.
I tasted the soup first...ha...it was the best!
Is it perilla seeds? The savory flavor was exquisite and deep.
It made me think of a taste similar to gamjatang.
Even the ingredients were plentiful... The main ingredient was tripe.
I'm so happy because it's so full of goop inside.
It's usually hard to see even though it's called tripe hotpot.
Here, because I stirred it with a ladle, it was revealed generously.
In addition, it is full of mushrooms, ham, and various ingredients ~
​
#Yukhoe Bibimbap 11,000 won
Wow, I really can’t help but introduce this menu!
It is a familiar Yukhoe Bibimbap that is commonly known.
At Janggo Sanghoe, raw fish, cockles, and soybean paste butter are available.
You can add soup, croquette salad, etc. to the rice bowl.
We ordered a generous amount of raw meat.
​The more you look at it, the more appetizing it becomes and the more you fill your mouth with it.
It was Yukhoe Bibimbap that made me even more happy.
It's a familiar taste, but like a Daehakro restaurant, Jango Sanghoe.
The menu really shows the charm of fusion + snack food.
​
#Pollack roe rose #Handmade croquette 8,500 won
The meal is well underway...
One more thing with a slightly regretful feeling about getting up!
I looked at the menu and my eyes fell on the pollack roe handmade croquette.
I ordered an additional one. The visuals are so luxurious.
Needless to say, the crispiness of the croquette was amazing.
The soft, fluffy potatoes inside are also the best.

reviews.author: Hanyang Monarch
reviews.text:
Musical Pub Curtain Call is a space where the expression ‘new challenge’ best fits. It's not just a place to watch a performance, but the experience of spending time in the same space with actors is something different. From the moment you open the door and enter, you feel a different atmosphere from a typical pub, and the lighting and props reminiscent of a performance hall naturally increase the sense of immersion. Above all, the biggest attraction of this place is the distance from the actors. You can feel the facial expressions, breathing, and energy of the actors in a space so close that you can barely feel the boundary between the stage and the audience, allowing you to become more immersed in the performance.
The performance flows without pressure and begins naturally like a conversation. In scenes where actors move between tables, make eye contact and communicate with the audience, there is a strong feeling of ‘having fun together’ rather than ‘watching’. As the emotions contained in each musical number are conveyed without the barrier of distance, you get new emotions even from familiar songs. Even first-time visitors will be able to blend in with the atmosphere without difficulty, so it will be a good experience even for those who are not familiar with musicals.
The food also exceeded expectations. Since it is a performance-centered space, I expected the food to be somewhat ordinary, but in reality, each and every snack was prepared with great care and the taste was high. It is a good composition to enjoy as a light snack while enjoying a performance, so it provides satisfaction without disrupting the flow. It is impressive that the taste, atmosphere, and performance come together naturally.
Overall, Curtain Call is a space that turns an ordinary day into a special memory. It's great for dates, gatherings with friends, or anyone looking for a new experience. This unique time of laughing, listening to songs, and sharing food with the actors in close proximity will not be easily forgotten. It is not an exaggeration to say that it is a ‘unique experience’, and it is a musical pub that you will definitely want to visit again.
